entities.name: José Luis Martínez Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Martínez Rodríguez (1918–2007) was a Mexican academic, diplomat, essayist, historian, bibliographer and editor. He was the director of the Fondo de Cultura Económica from 1977 to 1982 and professor of literature with the Faculty of Philosophy and Letters at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM).
